The '''rakghoul tunnels''' were series of cave and underground tunnels located beneath the surface of various worlds, such as [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where [[rakghoul]] infestations developed. Existence of the tunnels remained unknown until the [[Rakghoul pandemic|plague]] broke out on those worlds. [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] used [[The Spike (weapon)|the Spike]] to breach the tunnels and allow their forces to combat the infection.
